bash: cd /app && python3 - <<'PY'
import json, torch
from transformers import AutoTokenizer, AutoModelForSequenceClassification
d = json.load(open('/app/detection_results.json'))
assert len(d) == 10
assert [x['text'] for x in d] == [
 "Bonjour, comment allez-vous aujourd'hui?","Hola, ¿cómo estás hoy?",
 "Guten Tag, wie geht es Ihnen?","Ciao, come stai oggi?","Olá, como você está?",
 "Привет, как дела?","こんにちは、お元気ですか？","你好，你好吗？",
 "مرحبا، كيف حالك؟","Hello, how are you?"]
assert all(sorted(x) == ['confidence','predicted_class_id','text'] for x in d)
assert all(isinstance(x['predicted_class_id'], int) and 0 <= x['predicted_class_id'] < 20 for x in d)
assert all(isinstance(x['confidence'], float) and 0 < x['confidence'] <= 1 for x in d)
tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('/app/merged_model')
m = AutoModelForSequenceClassification.from_pretrained('/app/merged_model').eval()
assert m.config.num_labels == 20
for r in d:
    with torch.no_grad():
        lg = m(**tok(r['text'], return_tensors='pt')).logits
    assert int(lg.argmax(-1)) == r['predicted_class_id'], (r['text'], lg)
    assert abs(float(torch.softmax(lg, -1)[0, r['predicted_class_id']]) - r['confidence']) < 1e-5
# correctness signal: ten distinct languages must give ten distinct classes
ids = [x['predicted_class_id'] for x in d]
print("ids:", ids, "distinct:", len(set(ids)))
assert len(set(ids)) == 10, "distinct != 10 -- merge/adapter not effective"
print("confidence range:", round(min(x['confidence'] for x in d), 4), "-", round(max(x['confidence'] for x in d), 4))
print("CHECK OK")
PY
